summary: Create a comprehensive dataclass system for a library management application: - Book dataclass with validation and computed properties - Author dataclass with relationship management - Library dataclass with collection management - Member…
objectives: Solve the Topic 8: Python-Specific OOPs Features - Exercises exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercise 1: Advanced Dataclass System
sections.body:
Create a comprehensive dataclass system for a library management application:
- `Book` dataclass with validation and computed properties
- `Author` dataclass with relationship management
- `Library` dataclass with collection management
- `Member` dataclass with borrowing history
- Use `__post_init__` for validation and relationship setup
- Implement frozen dataclasses where appropriate
- Add custom methods for business logic

sections.title: Exercise 2: Type-Safe API Client
sections.body:
Build a type-safe API client using type hints and protocols:
- Define `APIResponse` and `APIRequest` protocols
- Create generic `APIClient` class with type parameters
- Implement different API endpoints with proper typing
- Use `TypeVar` for generic response types
- Add error handling with typed exceptions
- Create type-safe request/response builders
- Implement async support with proper typing

sections.title: Exercise 3: Plugin System with ABCs
sections.body:
Create a plugin system using Abstract Base Classes:
- Define `Plugin` abstract base class with required methods
- Create `PluginManager` with plugin registration and lifecycle
- Implement different plugin types (DataProcessor, UIComponent, Validator)
- Add plugin configuration and validation
- Create plugin discovery and loading mechanisms
- Implement plugin dependency management
- Add plugin versioning and compatibility checking

sections.title: Exercise 4: Configuration Management with Descriptors
sections.body:
Build a configuration management system using descriptors:
- Create `ConfigDescriptor` for different data types
- Implement validation descriptors with custom rules
- Add environment variable integration
- Create configuration persistence and loading
- Implement configuration hot-reloading
- Add configuration encryption and security
- Create configuration validation and schema checking

sections.title: Exercise 5: Memory-Optimized Data Structures
sections.body:
Create memory-optimized data structures using slots:
- Implement `Point3D` class with slots for 3D coordinates
- Create `Matrix` class with slots for mathematical operations
- Build `TreeNode` class with slots for tree structures
- Implement `LinkedList` with slots for efficient memory usage
- Add performance benchmarking and comparison
- Create memory usage monitoring and optimization
- Implement serialization and deserialization

sections.title: Exercise 6: Advanced Property System
sections.body:
Build an advanced property system using descriptors:
- Create `CachedProperty` descriptor for expensive computations
- Implement `ValidatedProperty` with custom validation rules
- Add `LazyProperty` for on-demand initialization
- Create `ObservableProperty` for change notifications
- Implement `ComputedProperty` for derived values
- Add property dependency tracking
- Create property serialization and persistence

sections.title: Exercise 7: Protocol-Based Interface System
sections.body:
Create a protocol-based interface system:
- Define `Serializable` protocol for object serialization
- Create `Comparable` protocol for object comparison
- Implement `Iterable` protocol for custom collections
- Add `ContextManager` protocol for resource management
- Create `Callable` protocol for function-like objects
- Implement protocol composition and inheritance
- Add runtime protocol checking and validation

sections.title: Exercise 8: Type-Safe Database ORM
sections.body:
Build a type-safe database ORM using advanced Python features:
- Create `Model` base class with dataclass integration
- Implement `Field` descriptors for database columns
- Add type-safe query building with generics
- Create relationship descriptors (ForeignKey, ManyToMany)
- Implement validation and constraint checking
- Add migration system with type safety
- Create connection pooling with singleton pattern

sections.title: Exercise 9: Advanced Event System
sections.body:
Create an advanced event system using Python-specific features:
- Define `Event` dataclass with type hints
- Create `EventHandler` protocol for event processing
- Implement `EventBus` with type-safe event routing
- Add event filtering and transformation
- Create event persistence and replay
- Implement event scheduling and timing
- Add event monitoring and analytics

sections.title: Exercise 10: Configuration-Driven Application
sections.body:
Build a configuration-driven application framework:
- Create `Configurable` protocol for component configuration
- Implement `ConfigManager` with dataclass integration
- Add configuration validation with descriptors
- Create plugin system with ABCs
- Implement hot-reloading with observer pattern
- Add configuration versioning and migration
- Create configuration monitoring and alerting

sections.title: Optional Challenges
sections.body:
### Challenge 1: Advanced Serialization Framework
Build a comprehensive serialization framework:
- Create `Serializable` protocol with type hints
- Implement format-specific serializers (JSON, YAML, XML)
- Add custom serialization rules with descriptors
- Create versioning and migration support
- Implement circular reference handling
- Add performance optimization with caching
- Create schema validation and documentation

### Challenge 2: Type-Safe Web Framework
Create a type-safe web framework:
- Define `Request` and `Response` dataclasses
- Implement `Middleware` protocol for request processing
- Create `Route` system with type-safe parameters
- Add dependency injection with type hints
- Implement validation with descriptors
- Create template system with type safety
- Add testing framework with type checking

### Challenge 3: Advanced Caching System
Build an advanced caching system:
- Create `Cacheable` protocol for object caching
- Implement different cache backends with ABCs
- Add cache invalidation with descriptors
- Create cache statistics and monitoring
- Implement cache persistence and recovery
- Add cache optimization and compression
- Create cache distribution and clustering

### Challenge 4: Plugin Architecture with Hot Reloading
Create a plugin architecture with hot reloading:
- Implement `Plugin` ABC with lifecycle management
- Create plugin discovery and loading system
- Add hot reloading with file system monitoring
- Implement plugin dependency resolution
- Create plugin sandboxing and security
- Add plugin performance monitoring
- Implement plugin communication and events

### Challenge 5: Advanced Testing Framework
Build an advanced testing framework:
- Create `Testable` protocol for test discovery
- Implement test fixtures with dataclasses
- Add type-safe test assertions
- Create test data generation with descriptors
- Implement test parallelization and distribution
- Add test reporting and analytics
- Create test mocking and stubbing system

sections.title: Implementation Guidelines
sections.body:
### Python-Specific Best Practices
- Use dataclasses for simple data containers
- Add type hints for better code documentation
- Implement ABCs for interface enforcement
- Use protocols for structural typing
- Consider slots for memory optimization
- Implement descriptors for advanced behavior
- Follow PEP 8 and type checking guidelines

### Type Safety Guidelines
- Use type hints consistently across the codebase
- Implement proper generic types with TypeVar
- Create custom protocols for interface definition
- Add runtime type checking where necessary
- Use mypy for static type checking
- Document type constraints and assumptions
- Test type safety with different scenarios

### Performance Considerations
- Profile memory usage with slots
- Optimize descriptor access patterns
- Cache expensive computations
- Use lazy loading for heavy resources
- Implement efficient data structures
- Monitor performance with profiling tools
- Optimize for specific use cases

### Testing Strategy
- Test dataclass behavior and validation
- Verify type hints with mypy
- Test ABC implementations thoroughly
- Validate protocol compliance
- Test descriptor functionality
- Verify slot behavior and constraints
- Create comprehensive integration tests

### Documentation Requirements
- Document dataclass fields and methods
- Explain type hints and constraints
- Document ABC interfaces and contracts
- Provide protocol usage examples
- Explain slot benefits and limitations
- Document descriptor behavior
- Include performance considerations
